question: The value of 3 + 12 + 27 + ___________ +3n² is:
solution:
**FORMULA USED:**

If 1² + 2² + 3² + ..........+ n² then, sum = n ( n +1) ( 2n +1)over 6

**CALCULATION:**

Here, 3 + 12 + 27 + ----------------- + 3n² 

Now, on taking 3 common 3 ( 1 + 4 + 9 + ------------------- + n² ).................(1)

Now, equation (1) can be written as

⇒ 3 ( 1² + 2² + 3² + ------------- + n² ) = 3 n ( n+1) ( 2n+1_)over 6 = n ( n+1) ( 2n +1)over2

**Hence, the required value is [n(n+1) (2n +1)]/2.**
